Farhan Ghosh
Data Engineer | Bengaluru
farhan.ghosh328@example.com | +91 9194228553

Early-career Data Engineer focused on building reliable ETL pipelines and data warehousing solutions for logistics operations. Skilled at translating operational requirements into automated workflows and performant SQL models. Comfortable collaborating across engineering and operations teams to deliver measurable throughput and data quality improvements.

Experience
Bluefin Logistics — Dec 2025 - Present
Data Engineer (Hybrid)
- Implemented Snowflake-based warehouse schemas and optimized large delivery-event tables using clustering and micro-partitions, reducing query cost by ~35% for daily operational reports; primary tools: Snowflake, SQL.
- Built Apache Airflow DAGs to orchestrate end-to-end ETL for fleet telemetry and shipment status, achieving near-real-time availability with average latency under 10 minutes; engineered retry and alerting logic using Airflow sensors and SLA callbacks.
- Developed Python data transformations and validation checks that caught 98% of previously undetected data anomalies before reporting, and automated data ingestion from S3 into Snowflake using COPY and AWS IAM roles.
- Automated monitoring on Linux hosts and integrated job run metadata and runbooks in Confluence for on-call teams, reducing mean time to resolution for pipeline failures by ~40%.

Projects
- Fleet Telemetry Ingestion: Built Python-based ingestion service that normalized GPS and sensor payloads, loaded into Snowflake via staged CSVs; enabled downstream analytics dashboards and reduced downstream join complexity by consolidating schemas.
- Daily ETA Pipeline: Created Airflow DAGs that computed shipment ETAs using historical travel times and live updates; SQL models refreshed materialized views hourly to support customer ETA notifications.

Skills
Languages: Python, SQL
Stack: Airflow, Snowflake, AWS
Tools: Linux, Confluence

Education
MCA, Symbiosis

Notice period: 15 days
